title: Puppet Master Settings System contracts
description: Strict Plans-only contracts for project Settings snapshots, transaction preview/apply/rollback/export, exact Settings routes and returns, manager/owner projections, Doctor projection boundaries, migration previews, appearance previews, UI action availability. These schemas and fixtures are not runtime or certification evidence. Includes a read-only exact-ID Settings Transfer draft preview and post-confirmation rebind to a real Project; no Project or Settings mutation is granted by a draft preview. Q22, Jared 2026-10-30 (DL-257): five families and ten variants; the independent NieR setting is retired.

setting_id.description: Current ordinary setting ID. Q22 retires general.visual.nier-mode to the load migration only; no current snapshot or transaction writes it.

settings_transaction_preview.description: The existing Project contract or the read-only Onboarding draft-target variant. Draft identities never enter apply as Project IDs.

settings_transaction_preview_request.description: The existing Project contract or the read-only Onboarding draft-target variant. Draft identities never enter apply as Project IDs.

provider_id.description: Optional (SSYS-019, SSYS-044): the provider whose section the route lands in, for a row drawn once per provider, such as the provider scope of a Settings control hosted on the Usage page. Absent keeps the target's existing meaning.

account_id.description: Optional (SSYS-019, SSYS-044; owner decision 2026-10-10 D43): the account inside provider_id whose own row the route lands on, for an account's own switch level hosted on its Usage account card. It needs provider_id.

owner_local_action_refs.description: Closed typed refs to Commands-owned local file actions (Plans/Commands_System.md#CS-081 census_action_id). These are owner-local actions with a sole native owner handler, not UICommand primaries: they must never appear in owner_action_ids, the catalog, or production wiring, and no cmd.* spelling may shadow them.

changes.description: Optional per-setting scope binding (SSYS-044). Each item names one setting id from exact_setting_ids, at most once; a non-inherit item's value equals proposed_values_by_setting_id for that id, and an inherit item clears the scoped value so the setting follows the next scope out again. Previews without changes keep their existing meaning.

source.description: Optional dotted name of the surface that raised the preview, for example usage.accounts for a Settings control hosted on the Usage page (SSYS-044). It is attribution only and grants no authority.

settings_write_scope.description: The scope a Settings preview writes at (SSYS-044). global is the shared value; provider is one provider's own value and needs provider_id; account is one account's own value inside that provider. Absent scope keeps the request's existing Project-scope meaning, so older requests stay valid. The apply request never restates scope or provider: both are bound by the preview it names.

settings_transaction_change.description: One scoped change in a Settings transaction preview request (SSYS-044). previous and previous_effective record what the caller showed before the change, its own value at that scope and the effective value, for rollback display and stale detection only; expected_destination_revision stays the authority.

owner_local_action_refs.description: Closed typed refs to Commands-owned local file actions (Plans/Commands_System.md#CS-081 census_action_id). These are owner-local actions with a sole native owner handler, not UICommand primaries: they must never appear in owner_action_ids, the catalog, or production wiring, and no cmd.* spelling may shadow them.

settings_transaction_result_v2.description: Live closed union: historical shapes without owner-copy contributions, or the selected evidence-bearing owner-copy edition. Historical owner-bearing definitions remain readable only. Static contract, no native evidence.

settings_transaction_preview_request_v3.description: Live closed union: historical shapes without owner-copy contributions, or the selected evidence-bearing owner-copy edition. Historical owner-bearing definitions remain readable only. Static contract, no native evidence.

settings_transaction_preview_v3.description: Live closed union: historical shapes without owner-copy contributions, or the selected evidence-bearing owner-copy edition. Historical owner-bearing definitions remain readable only. Static contract, no native evidence.

owner_thing_copy_contribution_v2.description: Selected owner-copy contribution v2. Preview evidence identifies the exact owner preview/hash. before_ref is the per-part restore point; done/rolled_back require owner after, readback and rollback evidence. recovery_required never claims completed readback. Historical v1 is read-only compatibility for owner-bearing copies, not admitted by the new live transaction unions.

cmd.project.settings_copy.apply.intended_semantics: Apply the current Settings preview atomically after creating the required restore point and return verification evidence.

cmd.project.settings_copy.preview.intended_semantics: Preview the exact cross-Project Settings transaction, selected categories, exclusions, validation, and rollback plan.

cmd.project.settings_copy.rollback.intended_semantics: Roll back the exact Settings-copy transaction using its verified rollback token and owner readback.
